title: Hi, I’m Sophia!
text:
Hi! My name is Sophia! I am a current UC San Diego, Rady School of Management, M.S. Business Analytics student! I have a foundation in data analytics, such as Python and SQL, and a creative passion with knowledge of Canva and Adobe Suite. I am passionate about utilizing data an trends to produce creative marketing strategies and analyses.
Welcome to my website!
Here you will find more about me and what I’ve been working on!

title: Words I Keep Coming Back To
text:
Some quotes and words that inspire how I think about creativity, work, and growth.


“The worst enemy to creativity is self-doubt.”

— Sylvia Plath



“Going through things you never thought you’d go through will only take you places you never thought you’d get to.”

— Morgan Harper Nichols



“What you think, you become. What you feel, you attract. What you imagine, you create.”

— Buddha



“Two roads diverged in a wood, and I — I took the one less traveled by. And that has made all the difference.”

— Robert Frost



“Anyone who has never made a mistake has never tried anything new.”

— Albert Einstein
